hypothesis: A fixed bivariate exponential Hawkes model of positive and negative structured-news arrivals, fitted without price outcomes on 2026-07-01..2026-07-20 and rolled forward from 2026-07-21, creates a signed conditional-intensity imbalance that can scale long-only notional in second-order SIC4/theme peers. The candidate qualifies only if its 25 frozen independent group-date decisions deliver positive, stable, diversified H10 SPY-excess after 45bp and beat equal-notional cohort controls; result ceiling observed_only.

provenance.baseline_policy: zero next-open-to-H10 SPY excess after the first-order public event; cash/SPY is the replacement value
provenance.price_clock: event published_at/event_date precedes the observer's next-regular-session-open entry and H10 settlement

independent_evidence.active_action: scale long-only group-date notional continuously when positive intensity exceeds negative intensity
form positive/negative arrival counts by deterministic SIC4 or theme group

expectation_gap.gap_definition: The price-revealed prior is zero residual peer return versus SPY after the next open. The independent posterior is not static polarity: it is the frozen conditional probability imbalance implied by the history of signed arrivals and their cross-excitation. A positive gap exists only if continuous Hawkes weighting improves net return versus holding the identical positive-score cohort equally and versus holding every eligible OOS group-date equally.

affected_tickers: unique second-order SIC4/theme peers excluding the first-order event name
transmission.catalyst: A cluster of signed public-news arrivals shifts the next-arrival sign intensity within an economic peer group.
transmission.expected_direction: Positive conditional-intensity imbalance predicts positive next-open-to-H10 SPY-excess in second-order peers; larger imbalance receives proportionally more long-only notional.
transmission.half_life: Two calendar days for arrival-state decay; price convergence is tested over ten market sessions.

why_not_arbitraged: The input is a diffuse second-order information state, not the headline itself. The edge requires combining a signed point-process posterior with a deterministic peer map, and then surviving costs and cross-sectional diversification. Static polarity on the same observer recently showed time instability, so the Hawkes state must prove incremental weighting value against same-cohort controls rather than inherit that claim.
falsifier: Reject without retuning unless all frozen bars pass: event-arrival OOS log-likelihood improvement > 0; mean and median group-date decision contributions after 45bp > 0; score-weighted net H10 SPY-excess per deployed dollar exceeds both the equal-notional positive-score cohort and equal-notional all-OOS group-date cohort; both chronological halves are positive; at least 4 of the 7 represented groups are positive; maximum group and maximum decision share of positive PnL are each <= 40%. Any failure freezes the half-life, group taxonomy, fit cutoff, score, cost and H10 horizon, and requires a new source/gate or >=38 independent settled group-dates across >=18 dates at <=40% max group share.

baseline.policy: Cash/SPY zero-excess replacement value, plus two equal-notional controls: the identical positive-score cohort and all eligible OOS group-dates.
baseline.universe: Out-of-replay structured-news events dated 2026-07-01..2026-08-15, grouped by SIC4/theme; trading read starts 2026-07-21 and requires at least three closed unique peer legs per group-date.

treatment.policy: At the observer's next regular-session open, allocate 4000 USD times the frozen positive Hawkes intensity-imbalance score to the group-date, equally across unique eligible peer tickers; settle at H10 close and subtract 45bp round-trip cost. No threshold search and no short side.

replacement_value_comparator: Zero SPY excess/cash, equal-notional long the same positive-score cohort, and equal-notional long all eligible OOS group-dates under the same H10 settlement and 45bp cost.

execution_envelope.capacity_constraint: Maximum 4000 USD per economic group-date times a score in [0,1], split equally across unique peers; observer result allocates no capital.
execution_envelope.costs_and_carry: Frozen 45bp round-trip cost per deployed peer notional; no financing or option carry.
execution_envelope.intended_instrument: Underlying listed cash equities only; no leveraged ETF, option, or synthetic mapping.
execution_envelope.liquidity_dependency: A later shared-paper build must apply price/liquidity caps and fail closed on missing legs; this attribution uses only already settled warehouse rows.
execution_envelope.timing_constraint: Only information available by the event decision clock enters the Hawkes state; entry is the next regular-session open and exit H10 close.

title: Signed-news Hawkes conditional-intensity notional scalar

prediction.confidence_reason: The event-only OOS likelihood and 25/12/7 density preflight are encouraging, but likelihood fit is not return predictability, the forward window is short, and static polarity propagation on the same observer recently failed stability/cost bars. Success is therefore set at one in five.

reopen_condition: If rejected, do not retune. Reopen only with a genuinely new data source or gate shape, or at least 38 settled independent group-date decisions across at least 18 dates while max group share remains <=40%.
next_machine_action: Validate outcome-blind D0-D3, reserve one observed-only attribution ID, execute the frozen read once, and leave all production behavior unchanged.
